Agora Road’s Macintosh Cafe portal

The Neocities portal of a forum for vaporwave and the old internet, built as a Windows 95 desktop inside a Mac OS window.

Source
agoraroad.neocities.org
Styles
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person), Pixel Art (partial fit; agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Nostalgic, ironic, cosy
Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • A lavender menu bar with a pixel font runs across the top, with a clock at the right and pixel icons down the right edge.
  • A central window with a pinstriped title bar reading “Agora Road’s Macintosh Cafe” frames a teal Windows 95 desktop with Start button, taskbar, and desktop icons.
  • Inside, a Control Panel window and an “ANTI GLOWY CHARM” dialog with a yellow warning icon and YES and NO buttons overlap a dithered pixel-art figure holding a glowing pyramid with an eye.
  • Below, a bold pixel-font welcome line, a short paragraph, outlined tag chips (vaporwave, nostalgia, art, macintosh, y2k), and square buttons.
  • The page background is a dim, blue-tinted photograph of a bedroom.

Why it belongs

The measurement finds hard, unblurred shadows on 29% of boxes with a 1.4 px median offset and zero radius: the two-step Windows bevel, drawn in CSS. It finds almost no gradient or pattern, because the backdrop is a photograph.

Borrow

Nest one period operating system inside another for the frame: it signals irony without any statue or sunset.
